ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 14, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design and French Commercial students on Monday, November 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 380 is offered online in the summer and winter terms. No exceptions will be made. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
